author: NorthEast News Desk
body: One person was seriously injured Thursday evening after being thrown from a vehicle in a two-car crash on Interstate 91 south in Windsor, Connecticut State Police said. The collision closed a section of the highway during the evening commute and remained under investigation overnight.

Connecticut Department of Transportation officials said the crash was reported at about 5:15 p.m. between Exits 36 and 35B. The agency reported the southbound closure while state police and emergency crews worked at the scene. The reported closure covered both a Windsor interchange and the adjoining southbound segment, making the incident a significant travel disruption for drivers using the corridor.

State police told the Connecticut Post that the person ejected from the vehicle was taken to Hartford Hospital by Windsor Emergency Medical Services with serious injuries. Authorities did not release the person's name, age or condition beyond that description. They also did not identify the other driver or disclose whether anyone else was hurt.

Multiple state police units responded, according to the Connecticut Post's account of the investigation. The newspaper reported that the scene was still active around 9:15 p.m., several hours after the crash was first reported. Police had not announced a cause, and the available reports did not say whether speed, impairment, weather, a medical event or another factor played a role. Those possibilities remain unconfirmed and should not be treated as explanations.

The transportation disruption continued into the night. The Connecticut Post reported heavy traffic near the closure at about 9:23 p.m., citing the Department of Transportation. Patch later reported that the highway reopened late Thursday night. The closure limits reported by CTDOT were the same in both accounts: southbound I-91 between Exits 36 and 35B.

Patch reported early Friday that Windsor EMS transported the injured person to Hartford Hospital and that Connecticut State Police were investigating. Patch also noted that the reports did not identify the person or explain what caused the crash. WFSB, which first reported the closure, separately described the incident as a two-vehicle crash and attributed the road information to CTDOT and the serious-injury information to state police.

For Windsor and neighboring communities, the immediate concern was the combination of a serious injury scene and a highway shutdown during a busy travel period. The reopening restored the route, but it did not resolve the questions surrounding the collision. Any later police statement could clarify the sequence of impact, the vehicles involved and whether additional charges or citations are warranted.

State police had not announced further details by early Friday. Until investigators release more information, the confirmed account is limited: a two-vehicle crash occurred on southbound I-91 in Windsor, one person was ejected and seriously injured, Windsor EMS took that person to Hartford Hospital, and the highway was closed and later reopened. Sources: [Connecticut Post](https://www.ctpost.com/journalinquirer/article/windsor-i-91-south-closed-crash-thursday-22458805.php), [Patch](https://patch.com/connecticut/windsor/person-seriously-injured-i-91-crash-windsor), and [WFSB](https://www.wfsb.com/2026/10/01/i-91-south-closed-windsor-after-crash/).
dek: A person was taken to Hartford Hospital with serious injuries after being ejected in a two-car crash that closed southbound I-91 in Windsor Thursday evening.
headline: Person seriously injured after ejection in Windsor I-91 crash
seoDescription: A person was ejected and seriously injured in a two-vehicle crash that closed southbound I-91 in Windsor.
seoTitle: Person seriously injured in Windsor I-91 crash
